title: AquaProbe: Efficient Adaptation of Frozen Vision Models for Underwater Images
abstract: arXiv:2610.40900v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable visual perception is essential for safe autonomous underwater exploration. Yet vision models pretrained on terrestrial images become less reliable underwater, where turbidity, backscatter, and wavelength-dependent attenuation alter scene appearance. Existing adaptation methods either spread adapters equally across the encoder depth or select layers using the divergence between two fixed domains. In this paper, we introduce AquaProbe for measuring how the location of the domain gap changes with water type and imaging range. AquaProbe separates newly introduced divergence from that accumulated through a frozen vision encoder using paired clean and physically rendered images and allocates a fixed LoRA budget according to the measured profile. translated_title: AquaProbe：冻结视觉模型在水下图像上的高效适配方法
translated_abstract: 可靠的视觉感知对于安全的自主水下探索至关重要。然而，在陆地图像上预训练的视觉模型在水下环境中可靠性会下降，因为浑浊度、后向散射和波长相关的衰减会改变场景的外观。现有的适配方法要么将适配器均匀分布在编码器的各层深度中，要么使用两个固定域之间的差异来选择层。在本文中，我们提出AquaProbe，用于测量域差异的位置如何随水体类型和成像距离的变化而改变。AquaProbe利用成对的干净图像和物理渲染图像，将新引入的差异与通过冻结视觉编码器累积的差异分离开来，并根据测量得到的分布曲线来分配固定的LoRA预算。基于测量分布曲线的比例化LoRA秩分配在分割任务上取得了70.1的平均交并比，优于均匀的LoRA秩分配方法。
tldr: 该论文提出AquaProbe方法，通过成对的干净图像与物理渲染图像测量域差异位置随水体类型和成像距离的变化规律，并据此按比例分配LoRA预算，实现了冻结视觉模型在水下图像上的高效适配，分割mIoU达到70.1，优于均匀分配方案。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AquaProbe, which measures how the location of the domain gap shifts with water type and imaging range using paired clean and physically rendered images, and allocates the LoRA budget proportionally according to the measured profile, enabling efficient adaptation of frozen vision models for underwater images with a segmentation mIoU of 70.1.
